text:
deploy-bot: Canary alarm: release 2.9.0 -> us-east-2 slice (10%) p95 latency 520ms > 350ms. Auto-rollback scheduled in 4m unless acknowledged. :warning:

liam.dev: saw the spike; traces point at a model-change diff that enables quant-opt heuristics. This looks like decode tail regression.

priya-sre: pinging @jen-releases and @anya-ops. There are two Dedicated customers in that slice; prefer a targeted pin vs full rollback.

jen-releases: options: 1) full rollback to 2.8.5 (fast); 2) pin VIPs to 2.8.5 while continuing canary; 3) try toggling quant flag at runtime. Which is lowest-risk?

anya-ops: we can patch routing for VIPs quickly: `releasesctl route pin --customer vip-acme --to 2.8.5 --duration 24h`. That avoids global revert.

liam.dev: I'd like to avoid broad rollback; let's pin VIPs and reduce canary to 2% while we triage.

deploy-bot: To suppress auto-rollback: `deploy-bot ack --by liam.dev --duration 30m`. Use `releasesctl traffic set --release 2.9.0 --slice us-east-2 --percent 2` to shrink.

priya-sre: executing pin: `releasesctl route pin --customer vip-acme --to 2.8.5 --duration 24h` -> done.

anya-ops: shrink canary: `releasesctl traffic set --release 2.9.0 --slice us-east-2 --percent 2` -> applied.

liam.dev: acked deploy-bot hold. Manual hold until 1755603400. We'll attempt a runtime flag flip on a tiny node pool to validate.

jen-releases: create customer-facing note: "We temporarily reduced rollout for a small portion of traffic due to elevated latency; VIP customers pinned to previous stable version. Investigating; no action required." Post to #customer-ops and add release note line.

priya-sre: running flag toggle on `staging-quant-1`: `releasesctl flag set --release 2.9.0 --name quant_heuristic --value false --scope staging-quant-1`. Starting 800-request probe.

deploy-bot: Manual annotation: `acknowledged_by: liam.dev`, `hold_expires_at: 1755603399`.

liam.dev: probe p95=295ms (baseline 280ms). No 5xx. Extend hold by 1h to validate production subset.

anya-ops: if flag toggle proves stable, plan: re-enable canary to 10% over 15m and keep VIP pin until patch release. Fallback: full rollback command below.

jen-releases: fallback rollback: `releasesctl rollback --from 2.9.0 --to 2.8.5 --regions us-east-2 --mode staged && notify --channel customer-ops --template rollback-latency`

liam.dev: flag toggle looks good. Proceeding to ramp to 8% over 12m and monitor. Keep VIP pin in place.

priya-sre: ramp command executed. Watching dashboards. p95 trending ~310ms.

jen-releases: created follow-up REL-5402 to gate `quant_heuristic` behind extended preflight and add regression test. Also drafted one-line for release notes: "VIP customers pinned; canary adjusted during latency investigation."

anya-ops: posted status to #customer-ops. Incident for audit INC-1901 created.

deploy-bot: Final: auto-rollback suppressed; no rollback executed. Handoff to REL-5402 and INC-1901. Thread closed after handoff.
